content.title: Core UI Design Principles for Audio Plugins
content.overview: Essential principles for designing professional audio plugin interfaces that balance aesthetics, usability, and performance.

principles.title: Visual Hierarchy
principles.description: Establish clear importance levels through size, position, and visual weight
guidelines: Use size to indicate importance - larger controls for frequently used parameters
Position primary controls in prime locations (top-left for Western audiences)
Create clear visual grouping for related parameters
Use contrast to highlight active/modulated parameters

principles.title: Modular Grid System
principles.description: Apply grid-based layouts for organized, balanced interfaces
guidelines: Use rule of thirds and golden ratio for pleasing proportions
Maintain consistent spacing and margins
Align elements to create visual rhythm
Apply 60-30-10 rule for layout distribution

principles.title: Color Theory Application
principles.description: Strategic use of color for visual appeal and functional clarity
guidelines: Limit palette to 2-3 primary colors plus accents
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text (WCAG AA)
Use color psychology - blue for trust, orange for energy
Don't rely solely on color - use icons and labels too

principles.title: Typography & Legibility
principles.description: Clear, readable text throughout the interface
guidelines: Maximum 2-3 typefaces across 2-3 sizes
Prioritize legibility over style
Use appropriate font sizes for different contexts
Ensure sufficient contrast between text and background

principles.title: Lighting & Materials
principles.description: Apply realistic lighting and material properties
guidelines: Use soft, photorealistic lighting
Apply believable glow effects for active elements
Choose pleasant material textures
Avoid extreme textures that cause visual fatigue

ux_patterns.description: Size and position correlate with usage frequency
ux_patterns.implementation: Larger buttons for more frequently used functions

ux_patterns.description: Dial indicator width impacts visual character
ux_patterns.implementation: Choose between thin or thick styles deliberately
Vertical for volume/level, horizontal for pan/spread

ux_patterns.description: Avoid circular checkboxes that confuse with radio buttons
ux_patterns.implementation: Use square or rounded squares instead

ux_patterns.description: Clear visual feedback for states and modulation
ux_patterns.implementation: Ensure sufficient width for easy interaction

design_workflow.step_1: Define 'The Feel' - establish emotional response with visual references
design_workflow.step_2: UX Layout First - create wireframes with forms, sizes, positions
design_workflow.step_3: Apply Modular Grids - use grid systems for clean organization
design_workflow.step_4: Limit Typefaces - maximum 2-3 typefaces across 2-3 sizes
design_workflow.step_5: Master Lighting - apply studio-quality lighting principles
design_workflow.step_6: Choose Materials - select pleasant virtual materials

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for UI components
accessibility.color: Don't rely solely on color - use icons and labels
accessibility.motion: Support reduced motion for vestibular disorders
accessibility.keyboard: All controls must be keyboard navigable

performance.optimization: Use bitmap caching for static elements
performance.lazy_loading: Load heavy visualizations only when visible
performance.gpu_acceleration: Consider OpenGL for highly animated UIs
